Ace of Wands.name: Ace of Wands

upright.waite: Creation, invention, enterprise, the powers which result in these; principle, beginning, source; birth, family, origin, and in a sense the virility which is behind them; the starting point of enterprises; according to another account, money, fortune, inheritance.
upright.waite_additional: Calamities of all kinds.
upright.etteilla: Nativity, origin, creation, source, spring, beginning, principle

reversed.waite: Fall, decadence, ruin, perdition, to perish; also a certain clouded joy.
reversed.etteilla: Cascade, abyss, gulf, precipice, decline, descent, waste away

Ace of Wands.image: A hand issuing from a cloud grasps a stout wand or club.

Two of Wands.name: Two of Wands

upright.waite: Between the alternative readings there is no marriage possible; on the one hand, riches, fortune, magnificence; on the other, physical suffering, disease, chagrin, sadness, mortification. The design gives one suggestion; here is a lord overlooking his dominion and alternately contemplating a globe; it looks like the malady, the mortification, the sadness of Alexander amidst the grandeur of this world's wealth.
upright.waite_additional: A young lady may expect trivial disappointments
upright.etteilla: Sadness, affliction, displeasure, pain, desolation, hopelessness, bleakness

reversed.waite: Surprise, wonder, enchantment, emotion, trouble, fear.
reversed.etteilla: Trick, deception, mistake, confusion, emotion, fear, fright, terror

Two of Wands.image: A tall man looks from a battlemented roof over sea and shore; he holds a globe in his right hand, while a staff in his left rests on the battlement; another is fixed in a ring. The Rose and Cross and Lily should be noticed on the left side.

Three of Wands.name: Three of Wands

upright.waite: He symbolizes established strength, enterprise, effort, trade, commerce, discovery; those are his ships, bearing his merchandise, which are sailing over the sea. The card also signifies able co-operation in business, as if the successful merchant prince were looking from his side towards yours with a view to help you.
upright.waite_additional: A very good card; collaboration will favour enterprise
upright.etteilla: Initiative, to begin, to undertake, to start, audacity, daring, temerity, boldness

reversed.waite: The end of troubles, suspension or cessation of adversity, toil and disappointment.
reversed.etteilla: Cessation of or a break in bad luck, torment, or exertions

Three of Wands.image: A calm, stately personage, with his back turned, looking from a cliff's edge at ships passing over the sea. Three staves are planted in the ground, and he leans slightly on one of them.

Four of Wands.name: Four of Wands

upright.waite: They are for once almost on the surface—country life, haven of refuge, a species of domestic harvest-home, repose, concord, harmony, prosperity, peace, and the perfected work of these.
upright.waite_additional: Unexpected good fortune.
upright.etteilla: Association, assembly, connection, federation, confederation, church, congregation

reversed.waite: The meaning remains unaltered; it is prosperity, increase, felicity, beauty, embellishment.
reversed.waite_additional: A married woman will have beautiful children
reversed.etteilla: Augmentation, increase, advancement, success, happiness, felicity, beauty

Four of Wands.image: From the four great staves planted in the foreground there is a great garland suspended; two female figures uplift nose-gays; at their side is a bridge over a moat, leading to an old manorial house.

Five of Wands.name: Five of Wands

upright.waite: Imitation, as, for example, sham fight, but also the strenuous competition and struggle of the search after riches and fortune. In this sense it connects with the battle of life. Hence some attributions say that it is a card of gold, gain, opulence.
upright.waite_additional: Success in financial speculation.
upright.etteilla: Wealth, opulence, sumptuousness, magnificence, radiance, luster, luxury, abundance

reversed.waite: Litigation, disputes, trickery, contradiction.
reversed.waite_additional: Quarrels may be turned to advantage
reversed.etteilla: Litigation, difference, quarrels, contestation, disputes, discussion, delaying tactic

Five of Wands.image: A posse of youths, who are brandishing staves, as if in sport or strife. It is mimic warfare, and hereto correspond the

Six of Wands.name: Six of Wands

upright.waite: The card has been so designed that it can cover several significations; on the surface, it is a victor triumphing, but it is also great news, such as might be carried in state by the King's courier; it is expectation crowned with its own desire, the crown of hope, and so forth.
upright.waite_additional: Servants may lose the confidence of their masters; a young lady may be betrayed by a friend.
upright.etteilla: Housework, home, servant, valet, lackey, maidservant, mercenary, inferior, slave

reversed.waite: Apprehension, fear, as of a victorious enemy at the gate; treachery, disloyalty, as of gates being opened to the enemy; also indefinite delay.
reversed.etteilla: Awaiting, expectation, expectancy, confidence, foresight, fear, apprehensiveness

Six of Wands.image: A laurelled horseman bears one staff adorned with a laurel crown; footmen with staves are at his side.

Seven of Wands.name: Seven of Wands

upright.waite: It is a card of valour, for, on the surface, six are attacking one, who has, however, the vantage position. On the intellectual plane, it signifies discussion, wordy strife; in business—negotiations, war of trade, barter, competition. It is further a card of success, for the combatant is on the top and his enemies may be unable to reach him.
upright.waite_additional: A dark child
upright.etteilla: Speech, to speak, to say, interview, colloquy, conversation, correspondence, deliberation

reversed.waite: Perplexity, embarrassments, anxiety. It is also a caution against indecision.
reversed.etteilla: Irresoluteness, uncertainty, perplexity, inconstancy, frivolity, fickleness, variety

Seven of Wands.image: A young man on a craggy eminence brandishing a staff; six other staves are raised towards him from below.

Eight of Wands.name: Eight of Wands

upright.waite: Activity in undertakings, the path of such activity, swiftness, as that of an express messenger; great haste, great hope, speed towards an end which promises assured felicity; generally, that which is on the move; also the arrows of love.
upright.waite_additional: Domestic disputes for a married person
upright.etteilla: Land, agriculture, farming, cultivation, tillage, properties, farm structures, peace, calm

reversed.waite: Arrows of jealousy, internal dispute, stingings of conscience, quarrels; and domestic disputes for persons who are married.
reversed.etteilla: Misunderstanding, regrets, remorse, repent, internal agitation, irresolution, uncertainty

Eight of Wands.image: The card represents motion through the immovable—a flight of wands through an open country; but they draw to the term of their course. That which they signify is at hand; it may be even on the threshold.

Nine of Wands.name: Nine of Wands

upright.waite: The card signifies strength in opposition. If attacked, the person will meet an onslaught boldly; and his build shews that he may prove a formidable antagonist. With this main significance there are all its possible adjuncts—delay, suspension, adjournment.
upright.waite_additional: Generally speaking, a bad card
upright.etteilla: Delay, putting-back, tardiness, dismissal, suspension, drawing out, lengthening, slowness

reversed.waite: Obstacles, adversity, calamity.
reversed.etteilla: Obstacle, impediment, contrariety, disadvantage, adversity, trouble, misfortune, unhappiness

Nine of Wands.image: The figure leans upon his staff and has an expectant look, as if awaiting an enemy. Behind are eight other staves—erect, in orderly disposition, like a palisade.

Ten of Wands.name: Ten of Wands

upright.waite: A card of many significances, and some of the readings cannot be harmonized. I set aside that which connects it with honour and good faith. The chief meaning is oppression simply, but it is also fortune, gain, any kind of success, and then it is the oppression of these things. It is also a card of false-seeming, disguise, perfidy. The place which the figure is approaching may suffer from the rods that he carries. Success is stultified if the Nine of Swords follows, and if it is a question of a lawsuit, there will be certain loss.
upright.waite_additional: Difficulties and contradictions, if near a good card
upright.etteilla: Disloyalty, betrayal, infidelity, conspiracy, corruption, malpractice, wrongdoing, crime

reversed.waite: Contrarieties, difficulties, intrigues, and their analogies.
reversed.etteilla: Impediment, hindrance, difficult position, struggle, inconvenience, opposition, effort

Ten of Wands.image: A man oppressed by the weight of the ten staves which he is carrying.

Page of Wands.name: Page of Wands

upright.waite: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a postman. Beside a man, he will bear favourable testimony concerning him. A dangerous rival, if followed by the Page of Cups. Has the chief qualities of his suit. He may signify family intelligence.
upright.waite_additional: Young man of family in search of young lady.
upright.etteilla: A foreigner, someone unknown or anonymous, strange, unusual, rare, uncommon

reversed.waite: Anecdotes, announcements, evil news. Also indecision and the instability which accompanies it.
reversed.etteilla: Announcement, notice, warning, admonition, education, instruction, teaching, lesson

Page of Wands.image: In a scene similar to the former, a young man stands in the act of proclamation. He is unknown but faithful, and his tidings are strange.

golden_dawn.attribution: Earth of Fire — Aries, Leo, Sagittarius

Knight of Wands.name: Knight of Wands

upright.waite: Departure, absence, flight, emigration. A dark young man, friendly. Change of residence.
upright.waite_additional: A bad card; according to some readings, alienation.
upright.etteilla: To leave, movement, transfer, distance, remoteness, sending away, absence, abandonment

reversed.waite: Rupture, division, interruption, discord.
reversed.waite_additional: For a woman, marriage, but probably frustrated
reversed.etteilla: Quarrel, rupture, disagreement, squabble, division, part, separation, partition

Knight of Wands.image: He is shewn as if upon a journey, armed with a short wand, and although mailed is not on a warlike errand. He is passing mounds or pyramids. The motion of the horse is a key to the character of its rider, and suggests the precipitate mood, or things connected therewith.

Queen of Wands.name: Queen of Wands

upright.waite: A dark woman, countrywoman, friendly, chaste, loving, honourable. If the card beside her signifies a man, she is well disposed towards him; if a woman, she is interested in the Querent. Also, love of money, or a certain success in business.
upright.waite_additional: A good harvest, which may be taken in several senses.
upright.etteilla: Country-dweller, villager, farmer, grower, woman of the woods, craftswoman, honesty

reversed.waite: Good, economical, obliging, serviceable. Signifies also—but in certain positions and in the neighbourhood of other cards tending in such directions—opposition, jealousy, even deceit and infidelity.
reversed.waite_additional: Good-will towards the Querent, but without the opportunity to exercise it
reversed.etteilla: Goodness, obliging, helpful, good deed, service, charity, alms, favor

Queen of Wands.image: The Wands throughout this suit are always in leaf, as it is a suit of life and animation. Emotionally and otherwise, the Queen's personality corresponds to that of the King, but is more magnetic.

King of Wands.name: King of Wands

upright.waite: Dark man, friendly, countryman, generally married, honest and conscientious. The card always signifies honesty, and may mean news concerning an unexpected heritage to fall in before very long.
upright.waite_additional: Generally favourable; may signify a good marriage.
upright.etteilla: Country-dweller, rustic, villager, peasant, farmer, plough-man, grower, agriculture, conscience

reversed.waite: Good, but severe; austere, yet tolerant.
reversed.etteilla: Indulgent severity, leniency, indulgence, kindness, tolerance, condescension

King of Wands.image: The physical and emotional nature to which this card is attributed is dark, ardent, lithe, animated, impassioned, noble. The King uplifts a flowering wand, and wears, like his three correspondences in the remaining suits, what is called a cap of maintenance beneath his crown. He connects with the symbol of the lion, which is emblazoned on the back of his throne.

golden_dawn.attribution: Air of Fire — Cancer 3°/Leo 1-2° (Crowley 'Prince of Wands')

Ace of Cups.name: Ace of Cups

upright.waite: House of the true heart, joy, content, abode, nourishment, abun­dance, fertility; Holy Table, felicity hereof.
upright.waite_additional: Inflexible will, unalterable law.
upright.etteilla: Table, meal, treat to a meal, food, nutrients, nutrition, feast, gala, invitation, guests, host, hotel, hospitality, inn, tavern, abundance, desk, altar, tablets, portfolio, catalog, data

reversed.waite: House of the false heart, mutation, instability, revolution.
reversed.etteilla: Change, mutation, permutation, transmutation, metamorphosis, alternation, vicissitude, inconstancy, frivolity, reversal, revolution, reversion, variety, variation, diversity, versatility, exchange, swap, purchase, sale, market, trade, convention, translation, interpretation, reading

Ace of Cups.image: The waters are beneath, and thereon are water-lilies; the hand issues from the cloud, holding in its palm the cup, from which four streams are pouring; a dove, bearing in its bill a cross-marked Host, descends to place the Wafer in the Cup; the dew of water is falling on all sides. It is an intimation of that which may lie behind the Lesser Arcana

Two of Cups.name: Two of Cups

upright.waite: Love, passion, friendship, affinity, union, concord, sympathy, the interrelation of the sexes, and—as a suggestion apart from all offices of divination—that desire which is not in Nature, but by which Nature is sanctified.
upright.waite_additional: Favourable in things of pleasure and business, as well as love; also wealth and honour.
upright.etteilla: Love, passion, inclination, sympathy, attraction, appeal, affinity, friendship, relationship, goodwill, affection, attachment, courtly love, gallantry, chivalry

reversed.etteilla: Desire, wish, vow, will, drive, urge, yearning, pipe dream, covetousness, cupidity, lust, jealousy, passion, appetite

Two of Cups.image: A youth and maiden are pledging one another, and above their cups rises the Caduceus of Hermes, between the great wings of which there appears a lion's head. It is a variant of a sign which is found in a few old examples of this card. Some curious emblematical meanings are attached to it, but they do not concern us in this place.

Three of Cups.name: Three of Cups

upright.waite: The conclusion of any matter in plenty, perfection and merriment; happy issue, victory, fulfilment, solace, healing.
upright.waite_additional: Unexpected advancement for military man.
upright.etteilla: Achievement, success, accomplishment, happy outcome, victory, healing, cure, relief, perfection

reversed.waite: Expedition, dispatch, achievement, end. It signifies also the side of excess in physical enjoyment, and the pleasures of the senses.
reversed.waite_additional: Consolation, cure. end of the business
reversed.etteilla: Business transaction, dispatches, execution, achievement, end, conclusion, termination

Three of Cups.image: Maidens in a garden-ground with cups uplifted, as if pledging one another.

Four of Cups.name: Four of Cups

upright.waite: Weariness, disgust, aversion, imaginary vexations, as if the wine of this world had caused satiety only; another wine, as if a fairy gift, is now offered the wastrel, but he sees no consolation therein. This is also a card of blended pleasure.
upright.waite_additional: Contrarieties.
upright.etteilla: Ennui, boredom, displeasure, discontentment, disgust, aversion, worry, spiritual anguish, grief, affliction, difficult, annoying, vexing, unpleasant, distressing, causing grief, disappointing

reversed.waite: Novelty, presage, new instruction, new relations.
reversed.etteilla: New knowledge or understanding, new directions, new information, new light, new details, new explanations, novelty, piece of information, indication, clue, sign, omen, portent, premonition, forecast, oracle, prediction, prophecy, divination

Four of Cups.image: A young man is seated under a tree and contemplates three cups set on the grass before him; an arm issuing from a cloud offers him another cup. His expression notwithstanding is one of discontent with his environment.

Five of Cups.name: Five of Cups

upright.waite: It is a card of loss, but something remains over; three have been taken, but two are left; it is a card of inheritance, patrimony, transmission, but not corresponding to expectations; with some interpreters it is a card of marriage, but not without bitterness or frustration.
upright.waite_additional: Generally favourable; a happy marriage; also patrimony, legacies, gifts, success in enterprise.
upright.etteilla: Heritage, inheritance, estate, legacy, holdings, legitimate, gift, donation, dowry, jointure, provision, grant, transmission, testament

reversed.waite: News, alliances, affinity, consanguinity, ancestry, return, false projects.
reversed.waite_additional: Return of some relative who has not been seen for long
reversed.etteilla: Parents, father, mother, brother, sister, uncle, aunt, cousin, blood, family, ancestors, forebears, inbreeding, race, line of descent

Five of Cups.image: A dark, cloaked figure, looking sideways at three prone cups; two others stand upright behind him; a bridge is in the background, leading to a small keep or holding.

Six of Cups.name: Six of Cups

upright.waite: A card of the past and of memories, looking back, as—for example—on childhood; happiness, enjoyment, but coming rather from the past; things that have vanished. Another reading reverses this, giving new relations, new knowledge, new environment, and then the children are disporting in an unfamiliar precinct.
upright.waite_additional: Pleasant memories.
upright.etteilla: The past, faded, withered, desiccated, preserved, old age, decrepitude, gone, formerly, previously, before, in older days, once, in the past, antiquity, antiques

reversed.waite: The future, renewal, that which will come to pass presently.
reversed.etteilla: The future, after, following, subsequently, later on, looking forward, tomorrow, next time, upcoming, hereafter

Six of Cups.image: Children in an old garden, their cups filled with flowers.

Seven of Cups.name: Seven of Cups

upright.waite: Fairy favours, images of reflection, sentiment, imagination, things seen in the glass of contemplation; some attainment in these degrees, but nothing permanent or substantial is suggested.
upright.waite_additional: Fair child; idea, design, resolve, movement.
upright.etteilla: Thought, mind, soul, spirit, intelligence, imagination, understanding, idea, memory, conception, opinion, feeling, meditation, contemplation, reflection, deliberation

reversed.waite: Desire, will, determination, project.
reversed.waite_additional: Success, if accompanied by the Three of Cups
reversed.etteilla: Projects, design, intention, desire, will, resolution, determination, premeditation

Seven of Cups.image: Strange chalices of vision, but the images are more especially those of the fantastic spirit.

Eight of Cups.name: Eight of Cups

upright.waite: The card speaks for itself on the surface, but other readings are entirely antithetical—giving joy, mildness, timidity, honour, modesty. In practice, it is usually found that the card shews the decline of a matter, or that a matter which has been thought to be important is really of slight consequence—either for good or evil.
upright.waite_additional: Marriage with a fair woman.
upright.etteilla: Blond girl, honest girl, reserved girl, honor, discretion, modesty, restraint, timidity, apprehension, sweetness

reversed.waite: Great joy, happiness, feasting.
reversed.etteilla: Satisfaction, pleasure, happiness, contentment, gaiety, joy, enthusiasm, rejoicing, entertainment, party, public joy, excuse, compensation, reparation, exoneration

Eight of Cups.image: A man of dejected aspect is deserting the cups of his felicity, enterprise, under-taking or previous concern.

Nine of Cups.name: Nine of Cups

upright.waite: Concord, contentment, physical bien-être; also victory, success, advantage; satisfaction for the Querent or person for whom the consultation is made.
upright.waite_additional: Of good augury for military men.
upright.etteilla: Victory, success, accomplishment, advantage, gain, winner, upper hand, lead, pomp, triumph, trophy, majesty, spectacle, parade, apparatus, gear

reversed.waite: Truth, loyalty, liberty; but the readings vary and include mistakes, imperfections, etc.
reversed.etteilla: Sincerity, truth, reality, loyalty, frankness, candor, liberty, familiarity, intimacy, ingenuousness, boldness

Nine of Cups.image: A goodly personage has feasted to his heart's content, and abundant refreshment of wine is on the arched counter behind him, seeming to indicate that the future is also assured. The picture offers the material side only, but there are other aspects.

Ten of Cups.name: Ten of Cups

upright.waite: Contentment, repose of the entire heart; the perfection of that state; also perfection of human love and friendship; if with several picture-cards, a person who is taking charge of the Querent's interests; also the town, village or country inhabited by the Querent.
upright.waite_additional: For a male Querent, a good marriage and one beyond his expectations.
upright.etteilla: Town, city, village, homeland, country, home, abode, dwelling, residence, citizens, place, site, location

reversed.waite: Repose of the false heart, indignation, violence.
reversed.etteilla: Anger, indignation, agitation, irritation, fit of anger, fury, violence, frenzy, rage, hatred, aversion, animadversion, animosity, antipathy, resentment, vengeance, affront, outrage, blasphemy, danger, risk, peril, injury, storm, tempest, gust, cruelty, brutality, inhumanity, atrocity

Ten of Cups.image: Appearance of Cups in a rainbow; it is contemplated in wonder and ecstacy by a man and woman below, evidently husband and wife. His right arm is about her; his left is raised upward; she raises her right arm. The two children dancing near them have not observed the prodigy but are happy after their own manner. There is a home-scene beyond.

Page of Cups.name: Page of Cups

upright.waite: Fair young man, one impelled to render service and with whom the Querent will be connected; a studious youth; news, message; application, reflection, meditation; also these things directed to business.
upright.waite_additional: Good augury; also a young man who is unfortunate in love.
upright.etteilla: Blonde boy, studious, study, diligence, application, work, activity, occupation, hobby, trade, employment, observation, reflection, consideration, meditation, contemplation

reversed.waite: Taste, inclination, attachment, seduction, deception, artifice.

Page of Cups.image: A fair, pleasing, somewhat effeminate page, of studious and intent aspect, contemplates a fish rising from a cup to look at him. It is the pictures of the mind taking form.

golden_dawn.attribution: Earth of Water — Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces

Knight of Cups.name: Knight of Cups

upright.waite: Arrival, approach—sometimes that of a messenger; advances, proposition, demeanour, invitation, incitement.
upright.waite_additional: A visit from a friend, who will bring unexpected money to the Querent.
upright.etteilla: Arrival, coming, approach, advent, entrance, reception, coming together, meeting, agreement, compliance, conformity, get closer, approximation, squeeze together, gathering, crowd

reversed.waite: Trickery, artifice, subtlety, swindling, duplicity, fraud.

Knight of Cups.image: Graceful, but not warlike; riding quietly, wearing a winged helmet, referring to those higher graces of the imagination which sometimes characterize this card. He too is a dreamer, but the images of the side of sense haunt him in his vision.

Queen of Cups.name: Queen of Cups

upright.waite: Good, fair woman; honest, devoted woman, who will do service to the Querent; loving intelligence, and hence the gift of vision; success, happiness, pleasure; also wisdom, virtue; a perfect spouse and a good mother.
upright.waite_additional: Sometimes denotes a woman of equivocal character.
upright.etteilla: Blonde woman, honest woman, an expert, virtue, ethics, values, wisdom, honesty, trustworthiness

reversed.waite: The accounts vary; good woman; otherwise, distinguished woman but one not to be trusted; perverse woman; vice, dishonour, depravity.
reversed.waite_additional: A rich marriage for a man and a distinguished one for a woman
reversed.etteilla: Woman of position, woman of a distinguished rank, dishonest woman, vice, dishonesty, depravity, debauchery, corruption, scandal

Queen of Cups.image: Beautiful, fair, dreamy—as one who sees visions in a cup. This is, however, only one of her aspects; she sees, but she also acts, and her activity feeds her dream.

King of Cups.name: King of Cups

upright.waite: Fair man, man of business, law, or divinity; responsible, disposed to oblige the Querent; also equity, art and science, including those who profess science, law and art; creative intelligence.
upright.waite_additional: Beware of ill-will on the part of a man of position, and of hypocrisy pretending to help.
upright.etteilla: Blond man, scientist, artist, probity, equity, integrity, principles

reversed.waite: Dishonest, double-dealing man; roguery, exaction, injustice, vice, scandal, pillage, considerable loss.
reversed.etteilla: Man of position, man of a high rank, dishonest man, scam, roguery, extortion, pillage, theft, brigand, rascal, corruption, waste, profligacy, squandering

King of Cups.image: He holds a short sceptre in his left hand and a great cup in his right; his throne is set upon the sea; on one side a ship is riding and on the other a dolphin is leaping. The implicit is that the Sign of the Cup naturally refers to water, which appears in all the court cards.

golden_dawn.attribution: Air of Water — Libra 3°/Scorpio 1-2° (Crowley 'Prince of Cups')

Ace of Swords.name: Ace of Swords

upright.waite: Triumph, the excessive degree in everything, conquest, triumph of force. It is a card of great force, in love as well as in hatred. The crown may carry a much higher significance than comes usually within the sphere of fortune-telling.
upright.waite_additional: Great prosperity or great misery.
upright.etteilla: Extreme, large, excessive, over-the-top, extremely, passionately, excessively, furious, choleric, fit of anger, fury, rage

reversed.waite: The same, but the results are disastrous; another account says—conception, childbirth, augmentation, multiplicity.
reversed.waite_additional: Marriage broken off, for a woman, through her own imprudence
reversed.etteilla: Pregnancy, engendering, conception, production, composition, birthing, childbirth

Ace of Swords.image: A hand issues from a cloud, grasping a sword, the point of which is encircled by a crown.

Two of Swords.name: Two of Swords

upright.waite: Conformity and the equipoise which it suggests, courage, friendship, concord in a state of arms; another reading gives tenderness, affection, intimacy. The suggestion of harmony and other favourable readings must be considered in a qualified manner, as Swords generally are not symbolical of beneficent forces in human affairs.
upright.waite_additional: Gifts for a lady, influential protection for a man in search of help.
upright.etteilla: Friendship, attachment, affection, tenderness, benevolence, liking, affinity, attraction, rapport, relationship, intimacy, sympathy

reversed.waite: Imposture, falsehood, duplicity, disloyalty.

Two of Swords.image: A hoodwinked female figure balances two swords upon her shoulders.

Three of Swords.name: Three of Swords

upright.waite: Removal, absence, delay, division, rupture, dispersion, and all that the design signifies naturally, being too simple and obvious to call for specific enumeration.
upright.waite_additional: For a woman, the flight of her lover.
upright.etteilla: Distance, departure, absence, removal, dispersion, misanthropy, antisocial, disdain, aversion, incompatibility, separation, division

reversed.waite: Mental alienation, error, loss, distraction, disorder, confusion.

reversed.etteilla: Confusion, dementia, wandering, spiritual alienation, distraction, mad conduct, error

Three of Swords.image: Three swords piercing a heart; cloud and rain behind.

Four of Swords.name: Four of Swords

upright.waite: Vigilance, retreat, solitude, hermit's repose, exile, tomb and coffin. It is these last that have suggested the design.
upright.waite_additional: A bad card, but if
upright.etteilla: Solitude, desert, exile, banishment, proscription, retirement, hermitage, uninhabited, isolated, abandoned, tomb

Four of Swords.image: The effigy of a knight in the attitude of prayer, at full length upon his tomb.

Five of Swords.name: Five of Swords

Six of Swords.name: Six of Swords

Seven of Swords.name: Seven of Swords

upright.waite: Design, attempt, wish, hope, confidence; also quarrelling, a plan that may fail, annoyance. The design is uncertain in its import, because the significations are widely at variance with each other.
upright.waite_additional: Dark girl; a good card; it promises a country life after a competence has been secured.

Eight of Swords.name: Eight of Swords

He is passing over rugged land, and about his way the clouds are collocated wildly. He is alert and lithe, looking this way and that, as if an expected enemy might appear at any moment.

golden_dawn.attribution: Earth of Air — Gemini, Libra, Aquarius

It does not represent mercy, and, her sword notwithstanding, she is scarcely a symbol of power.

King of Swords.name: King of Swords

upright.waite: Whatsoever arises out of the idea of judgment and all its connexions—power, command, authority, militant intelligence, law, offices of the crown, and so forth.

golden_dawn.attribution: Air of Air — Capricorn 3°/Aquarius 1-2° (Crowley 'Prince of Swords')

Ace of Pentacles.name: Ace of Pentacles

upright.waite: attached thereto. King of Pentacles.image: The figure calls for no special description; the face is rather dark, suggesting also courage, but somewhat lethargic in tendency. The bull's head should be noted as a recurrent symbol on the throne. The sign of this suit is represented throughout as engraved or blazoned with the pentagram, typifying the correspondence of the four elements in human nature and that by which they may be governed. In many old Tarot packs this suit stood for current coin, money, deniers. I have not invented the substitution of pentacles and I have no special cause to sustain in respect of the alternative. But the consensus of divinatory meanings is on the side of some change, because the cards do not happen to deal especially with questions of money.
